newsitem.title: FINLAND: SAVON SANOMAT SEES BETTER 1996 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: SAVON SANOMAT SEES BETTER 1996 EARNINGS.

text.p: Finnish media group Savon Sanomat Oy said on Friday it expects its full-year 1996 earnings to improve on 1995 despite a rise in raw material costs.

"Even though particularly raw material costs have increased significantly, the markka-denominated operating profit before depreciation and the group's earnings for the financial year are expected to be higher than last year," Savon Sanomat said in a statement with its January-August results.
In 1995, Savon Sanomat had a 19.9 million markka profit before extraordinaries. Its operating profit before depreciation was 35.8 million markka.
Savon Sanomat said earlier its January-August profit before extraordinary items rose to 16.9 million markka from 13.5 million markka.
